title: Corrective fix for B-40c6c189: Shared review for AddItemSheet aisle picker persistence fix
description:
Blocked reason: setAisleProgrammatically does not guard against same-value writes. When selectedAisle already holds the target value, onChange(of: selectedAisle) does not fire, leaving isProgrammaticAisleUpdate=true permanently. The next genuine user picker tap clears the flag but skips isAisleManuallySelected=true, allowing auto-detect to override the user's choice on the next keystroke. Fix: add `guard selectedAisle != aisle else { return }` as the first line of setAisleProgrammatically.

Remaining work: Fix setAisleProgrammatically to guard against same-value writes (guard selectedAisle != aisle else { return }). Add a test exercising the sticky-flag path. Re-run tester to confirm no regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Implement the minimum fix required to unblock B-40c6c189.
Update tests/docs as needed for the corrective change.
Leave a handoff summary that states how the parent bead can be retried.
conflict_risks: Low. Fix is confined to a single private helper in AddItemSheet.swift. No shared files touched.
